tests.name: TSH
tests.explanation_en: Your TSH (8.72 mIU/L) is above the usual range (0.4–4.0 mIU/L). An elevated TSH may indicate an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism). Please discuss this with your doctor.

tests.explanation_ta: உங்கள் Free T4 அளவு (0.62 ng/dL) சாதாரண வரம்பை விட குறைவாக உள்ளது. உங்கள் மருத்துவரிடம் ஆலோசிக்கவும்.

summary_en: This lab report shows 7 test results. TSH is elevated and Free T4 is low, suggesting hypothyroidism. Anti-TPO antibodies are significantly raised, indicating a possible autoimmune thyroid condition. Additionally, Total Cholesterol, LDL, and Triglycerides are above normal, and HDL (good cholesterol) is low, indicating mixed dyslipidemia. Please review all these findings with your doctor promptly.
